items.summary: “Operation Sindoor, Balakot Airstrikes and Surgical Strikes weren’t just military operations; they symbolised a decisive shift in the nation’s approach, moving from diplomatic condemnation to proactive action aimed at rooting out terrorism by reaching its very source,” said Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh at a Defence Conclave in New Delhi on October 15, 2026. items.title: Op Sindoor, Balakot Airstrike & Surgical Strike reflect India’s shift from diplomatic condemnation to proactive action to eliminate terrorism at its source: Raksha Mantri
